hypotheses.rationale: Day 10 confirms the established weekday pattern: early wake-up (07:53) and consistent return time (17:12). The absence of any midday work-related object movement further solidifies the off-site work hypothesis.

Still theoretically possible if work is entirely off-camera, but the consistent lack of 'work' object movement during core hours (11:55 on Day 8, no new work objects on Day 10) makes this increasingly improbable.
Contradicted by consistent early morning activity (07:53) and clear weekday/weekend distinction. No evidence of night activity or late departures.
